content.title: Solutions and global reach in Aerospace, Defence & Security | Leonardo
content.text: Leonardo Profile Solutions and global reach in Aerospace, Defence & Security - Company Leonardo is a global industrial group that builds technological capabilities in Aerospace, Defence & Security. The company plays a prominent role in major international strategic programmes and is a trusted technological partner of governments, defence agencies, institutions and enterprises. Leonardo at a Glance Leonardo 2025 Annual Report Summary Domestic market Business Areas AERONAUTICS AUTOMATION CYBER & SECURITY ELECTRONICS HELICOPTERS HPC SPACE INDUSTRIAL PLAN UPDATE 2026 discover more Main Shareholdings and Joint Ventures AgustaWestland Philadelphia Corporation Helicopters (100%) Production, assembly, marketing and customer support of helicopters and tiltrotors. AWPC ATR Regional turboprop aircraft (50%) Leader in the production of regional turboprop aircraft for passenger transport, special missions and cargo. ATR Avio Space propulsion (19%) Design, development, production and integration of space launchers and of solid and liquid fuel propulsion systems for tactical missiles, space launchers and satellites. Avio Axiomatics AB Cyber Security 100% The only European player to offer a platform enabling Zero Trust architecture for authorisation management and data security with dynamic access control based on the ABAC (Attribute-Based Access Control) model. Axiomatics AB EDGEWING LTD Aircraft (33.3%) Industrial reference for the GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme) for the development of the sixth-generation air combat system. The company will lead the development of the aircraft, maintaining its role as design authority throughout its entire life cycle, with entry into service scheduled for 2035 and operations beyond 2070. EDGEWING LTD ELT GROUP Defence electronics (31.33%) Design, development and production of strategic surveillance, self-defence and electronic attack systems for naval, air and land armed and government forces, internationally. Elt Group Hensoldt Defence electronics (22.8%) Leading manufacturer of sensors for defence and security applications. Hensoldt Kopter Helicopters (100%) Development of a new generation of light helicopters with advanced hybrid/electric propulsion technologies. Kopter Larimart Defence electronics (60%) Design and development of telecommunications solutions in the Defence, Security and Emergency fields. Larimart LBA Systems Unmanned aerial systems (50%) Design, development, production, and maintenance of unmanned aerial systems. LBA Systems Leonardo Aviation Services Integrated Logistic Solutions (100%) The company acts as an enabler and supporter for the Kuwait Air Force, guaranteeing sustainment and integrated training solutions for aircrew and ground crew, to keep the Eurofighter Typhoon weapon system “mission ready” with the highest safety standards. Leonardo DRS Defence electronics (71,38%) Design, development and manufacture of integrated products, services and support for military forces, intelligence agencies, and leading defence contractors around the world. Leonardo DRS Leonardo Global Solutions Services (100%) Leonardo’s Service Provider, it operates as Procurement Competence Center, Global Real Estate Provider, Business and People Care Services Manager, and Environmental Risk Manager, supporting business in Italy and abroad. Leonardo Global Solutions Leonardo International International equity investment management (100%) Management, monitoring and control of shareholdings in companies operating in international markets (outside the UK, Poland and the USA) with the aim of harmonising the operational standards in relation to the Parent Company and providing support in terms of planning and management control. Leonardo Logistics Logistics (100%) Industrial logistics services, optimised transport management and service provider of standard materials, integrated by specialised engineering and Advanced Logistics 4.0 solutions, with digitisation and technological innovation for integrated and sustainable logistics. Leonardo Logistics Leonardo UK Helicopters / Defence Electronics (100%) Development and production of civil and military helicopters, electronic systems and cyber solutions in the defence and security field. Leonardo UK LRMV Land defence systems (50%) Development and commercialisation of fully digitalised last generation combat vehicles, capable of providing state-of-the-art defence capabilities and acting in a multi-domain context. Leonardo - Rheinmetall Military Vehicles MBDA Defence systems (25%) Design, development and production of missiles and missile systems for all types of platforms and for the main market sectors. MBDA PZL Świdnik Helicopters (100%) Design, development and production of helicopters. Telespazio Thales Alenia Space Satellite production (33%) Design, development and production of dual-satellite systems for telecommunications, environmental and terrestrial climate monitoring, defence and security, scientific exploration and research, and space infrastructure.
